title: Huawei Accelerates Tau Chip Rollout as Mate XT 2 Nears 1 Million Sales
detail: Huawei is stepping up the rollout of its domestically developed Tau chip as the Mate XT 2 smartphone approaches 1 million units sold. The milestone signals continued progress in China's semiconductor self-sufficiency drive, demonstrating Huawei's ability to scale advanced chip production despite US export controls.
